rationale: The two shapes that genuinely ARE an API contract, and the only two this lane fills `apiContractPath` for: an OpenAPI operation and a GitHub Actions step. A YAML key is not an API surface, so the field stays absent everywhere else rather than carrying a constant -- which is why `info` and `definitions.Task` have no apiContractPath here. OpenAPI is also the lane's largest real-world shape: 54% of all corpus symbol volume comes from twelve Swagger files, and nothing read any of it before.

_everyRelationshipCarries.note: asserted by the lane census over 1,274 corpus files: 308,987/308,987 relationships carry a 1-based line_number and an evidenceClass
